stories.title: At least 22 dead, several injured, in fire at DR Congo wedding reception
stories.summary: A fire at a wedding party in Democratic Republic of Congo’s capital Kinshasa left at least 22 people dead, the regional mayor said on Saturday. Several others were injured. The fire started on Friday night and continued into early Saturday in a building in Lingwala in northern Kinshasa. The building’s narrow hallways were constricted by people trying to escape the fire. stories.title: IRGC says it attacked six vessels near Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: IRGC says it attacked six vessels near Strait of Hormuz Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy says it struck three oil tankers travelling through “unauthorised” routes in the Strait of Hormuz and three US-affiliated vessels “in other areas”. In a statement carried by Iranian broadcaster IRIB, the force urged ships in the Gulf and around the strait not to be “deceived” by the US military. It also warned vessels to “refrain from any suspicious movement aimed at transiting unauthorised waterways”. “Otherwise, you will be targeted,” it said.
